column1: # Built-in display names of system families and other interface texts, kept so that exported property names equal the names found in exported documents (interoperability values); maintained by the project.
# One row per text the reader can request, for the cultures en-US and ru-RU.
# Columns (tab separated): culture, key, text. The key is a SystemFamilyKind or RevitUiText member name, or StairOccurrenceName.
# In the text a backslash, tab, line feed and carriage return are written as \\, \t, \n and \r.
